description: Project college savings growth from current savings, monthly contributions and returns — and check the shortfall against a target cost.

faqs.a: Future value = current savings grown with interest + future value of the monthly contribution annuity. Both compound at the assumed annual return.
The contribution annuity is assumed to be paid monthly and to compound monthly at the annual return ÷ 12.
Returns are never guaranteed. Try a lower (conservative) and higher (optimistic) return to see a range of outcomes.

howto: Enter current savings, monthly contribution and years until college.
Set an expected annual return and the target college cost.
Read the projected value and the funding shortfall.
title: College Savings Calculator
